scope: fixed global order with patient-specific NEXT/STOP; no free-choice acquisition

state_contract.observed_values: base features plus the acquired fixed-order prefix
state_contract.acquisition_mask: base observed by contract; candidate prefix marked acquired
state_contract.source_observation_mask: separately records whether each retrospectively requested source value exists
state_contract.current_prediction: 3-year incident-T2D risk from the current prefix Cox model
state_contract.available_next_action: the next single candidate in the fixed order
state_contract.candidate_cost: cost of that next candidate under the named scheme

ordered_policy.name: ordered_risk_gate_v1
ordered_policy.decision_rule: at stages 0-5 choose NEXT when current 3-year risk >= threshold; otherwise STOP; force STOP after stage 6
ordered_policy.missing_result_rule: charge the requested action, retain the participant, and use the train-fitted imputation value when the retrospective source result is missing

tuning.threshold_candidate_source: quantiles of train prefix risks at decision stages
tuning.selection_metric: Harrell C-index retention relative to Base Only and Full Features
tuning.selection_rule: minimum mean primary-scheme cost among candidates retaining the target fraction of the validation C-index improvement

evaluation.brier: single-horizon IPCW; censoring distribution estimated on train only

acquisition.missing_result_rule: charge the requested action; use the train-fitted imputation value; retain the participant and continue normal NEXT/STOP evaluation
